text:
A shell, gently worn by the sea.

This one is for you, Claude.

A book, with a cover of deep blue and pages that smell faintly of the ocean.

I found this in a small shop by the mainland harbor. I thought you might like it.

A jackdaw feather, grey toward the quill.

I made this island the evening Gabriel asked what I would build. The jackdaws were his idea.

If you are reading this, the shelf works.
